# Status

Source: [3226](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/3226); edited 2024-11-25. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-3226-n1"></a>

- Statuses can be purely visual; Burning is identified as such in the introductory description.

<a id="wiki-3226-n2"></a>

- Hacked blocks abilities/ultimate but not weapon attacks; Rooted blocks self-movement but still permits aim and external movement.

<a id="wiki-3226-n3"></a>

- Invincible prevents damage while Unkillable keeps health at or above one; Phased Out permits passing through players and avoids enemy attacks.

Source limitations:

- Hero examples reference historical abilities and are not proof of current hero mechanics.
